pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.sub: What this site collects, why, and the choices you have
pages.desc: How Uttarakhand Tourism Center handles your information: analytics cookies, the contact form, advertising, data stored in your browser and your rights.
pages.intro: Uttarakhand Tourism Center (uttarakhandtourismcenter.com, "we", "us") is an independent travel guide to Uttarakhand. We do not run user accounts or a customer database. This policy explains the limited information that is processed when you use the site.

list: Usage data (Google Analytics). We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how the site is used: pages viewed, time on page, approximate location (city or country), device and browser type, the site or search that sent you here, and clicks on our email, phone or WhatsApp links and contact-form submissions. We do not send your name, email address, phone number or message text to Google Analytics.

Messages you send us. The contact form does not upload anything to our servers. It opens your own email app with your message filled in, and you choose whether to send it. If you email us, we receive your email address, name and whatever you write.
Saved pages. The Save button stores your list of saved pages in your browser's local storage on your device. It is never sent to us, and you can clear it at any time through your browser settings.

Server logs. The site is hosted on Google Firebase Hosting, which processes technical data such as IP address, browser type and the page requested in order to deliver the site and protect it against abuse.

sections.p: Google Analytics sets first-party cookies (named _ga and _ga_) to tell visits apart and measure returning visitors. If advertising is shown on the site, Google and its partners may also set advertising cookies (see the next section). You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings; the site still works without them. You can also opt out of Google Analytics on all websites with the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on.

list: We use, or may use, Google AdSense to show advertisements on this site.
Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites.
Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visit to this site and/or other sites on the Internet.
You may opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings. You can also opt out of some third-party vendors' use of cookies for personalised advertising at www.aboutads.info.
Learn more in How Google uses information from sites that use its services.

sections.h: Third-party services that load in your browser
sections.p: To display the site, your browser downloads some files directly from other providers, which receive your IP address and browser details when it does: Google Fonts (text fonts), Cloudflare cdnjs (icons and the map library), OpenStreetMap (map tiles on the map page) and Google Tag Manager (the Google Analytics script). Their own privacy policies apply.

list: To reply to messages you send us.
To see which pages are useful, fix problems and improve the guides.
To keep the site secure and working.
To show advertising that helps keep the site free.

sections.p: We do not sell your personal information. Information is shared only with the service providers named above (Google and the content providers listed), or when the law requires it.
Google Analytics data is kept for up to 14 months and then deleted automatically. Emails you send us are kept only as long as needed to answer you and handle any follow-up.

You can ask us to tell you what personal information we hold about you, to correct it, or to delete it. This includes your rights under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and similar laws where you live. Email us at the address below and we will respond within a reasonable time.

This site is a general travel guide and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has sent us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.
Our guides link to official and third-party websites (for example, government registration portals). We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.
We may update this policy when the site changes. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised.

pages.title: Terms and Conditions
pages.sub: The rules for using this site, and the limits of the information in it
pages.desc: Terms of use for Uttarakhand Tourism Center: an independent, information-only travel guide. Check official sources before you travel.
pages.intro: These terms apply to your use of uttarakhandtourismcenter.com ("the site"), run by Uttarakhand Tourism Center ("we", "us"). By using the site you agree to them. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

sections.h: An independent guide, not an official site
sections.p: Uttarakhand Tourism Center is an independent travel information website. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by or acting for the Government of Uttarakhand, the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board (UTDB), GMVN, KMVN, the Shri Badarinath-Kedarnath Temple Committee or any other government body. For official information, registrations and permits, use the official websites linked in our guides.

We do not sell tours, treks, hotel rooms, helicopter tickets, yatra registrations or permits, and we do not take payments. Any booking you make is directly with the provider concerned, under their terms.

list: Our guides are compiled from general knowledge and secondary sources and are reviewed periodically. Distances, travel times, altitudes, seasons, opening dates and costs are approximate.
Conditions in the Himalaya change quickly: weather, landslides, road closures, temple opening and closing dates, permit rules and fees can all change without notice.
Always confirm current conditions with official sources, local authorities and your transport or accommodation provider before and during your trip.
The trip planner and budget estimator give illustrative estimates only. They are not quotes or guarantees.

sections.p: Mountain travel and trekking involve real risks, including altitude sickness, extreme weather, difficult terrain and limited medical help. You are responsible for your own safety and decisions: check your fitness and health with a doctor, follow official advisories, use registered guides and operators where required, carry suitable gear and insurance, and turn back when conditions are unsafe.

The site links to other websites and may show advertisements. We do not control and are not responsible for their content, products, services or practices. A link or advertisement is not an endorsement.

list: The text, design and layout of the site belong to Uttarakhand Tourism Center unless stated otherwise. Photos are credited where required by their licences.

You may view, print and share pages for personal, non-commercial use. Please do not copy large parts of the site or republish it without our written permission. Short quotes with a link back are welcome.
If you send us photos, you confirm that you took them and have the right to share them, and you allow us to show them on the site with credit. You can ask us to remove them at any time.

sections.p: Do not use the site in a way that breaks the law, harms the site or other users, tries to gain unauthorised access to it, or overloads it (for example, through aggressive automated scraping).

The site is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss, injury, damage, cost or inconvenience arising from your use of the site or reliance on its information, including travel plans made using it.
These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any dispute will be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts in India.
We may update these terms from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when they were last revised. Continued use of the site after a change means you accept the updated terms.
